reading: Japan is currently contending with the aftermath of an unprecedented weather phenomenon, as torrential rainfall has caused significant fatalities and extensive infrastructure damage.
The severe meteorological event has tragically resulted in eight confirmed deaths across various regions, underscoring the formidable power of the downpour.
Beyond the grim human cost, the deluge has severely impacted daily life for tens of thousands of residents.
Authorities reported that the storm effectively cut power to more than 20,000 households, plunging communities into darkness and disrupting essential services.
This widespread electrical failure compounded the challenges faced by emergency response teams operating in adverse conditions.
Furthermore, the severe weather led to considerable transportation chaos, most notably at Tokyo's Narita International Airport.

A significant consequence was that approximately 7,000 travellers found themselves stranded at the airport, unable to proceed with their journeys due to flight cancellations and ground transport issues.
The situation at Narita underscored the broader disruption caused by the extreme precipitation across the Kanto region.
Emergency services have been mobilised to address immediate needs, including rescue operations and the restoration of critical utilities.
The government is now assessing the full scale of the devastation and coordinating recovery efforts following this natural disaster which claimed a grim toll of lives.

vocabulary.definition: Extremely heavy and abundant rain that falls very quickly and continuously, often leading to flooding.
The distressing or tragic number of deaths, casualties, or negative consequences resulting from an event.
Emphasizing or highlighting the importance of something; serving to stress a point or demonstrate a particular quality.
a problem that stops normal activity
the basic networks and facilities on which an activity or society depends
Deaths caused by an accident, disaster, or violence.
difficult to overcome because of great strength or scale
an event or process that can be observed
covering a large area or involving many parts
organised people or resources so they were ready for action

entries.ja: 非常に速く、絶え間なく降る極めて激しい大量の雨で、しばしば洪水を引き起こします。
entries.ko: 매우 빠르고 지속적으로 내리는 극도로 많고 격렬한 비로, 종종 홍수를 유발합니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 指非常迅速且持续不断地落下，极其大量而猛烈的雨水，通常会导致洪水。
entries.es: Lluvia extremadamente intensa y abundante que cae muy rápido y de forma continua, a menudo provocando inundaciones.
entries.pt-BR: Chuva extremamente forte e abundante que cai muito rapidamente e de forma contínua, frequentemente resultando em inundações.
entries.fr: Pluie extrêmement forte et abondante qui tombe très rapidement et sans interruption, entraînant souvent des inondations.
entries.de: Extrem starker und reichlicher Regen, der sehr schnell und ununterbrochen fällt und oft zu Überschwemmungen führt.

entries.ja: ある出来事によって生じた、心を痛める、または悲劇的な死者、負傷者、あるいは負の結果の数。
entries.ko: 어떤 사건으로 인해 발생한 비통하거나 비극적인 사망자, 사상자 또는 부정적인 결과의 수.
entries.zh-Hans: 指某个事件造成的令人痛心或悲剧性的死亡、伤亡或负面后果的数量。
entries.es: El número angustioso o trágico de muertes, víctimas o consecuencias negativas resultantes de un evento.
entries.pt-BR: O número aflitivo ou trágico de mortes, vítimas ou consequências negativas resultantes de um evento.
entries.fr: Le nombre affligeant ou tragique de décès, de victimes ou de conséquences négatives résultant d'un événement.
entries.de: Die erschreckende oder tragische Anzahl von Todesfällen, Opfern oder negativen Folgen, die aus einem Ereignis resultieren.

entries.ja: 何かの重要性を強調すること。ある点を力説したり、特定の性質を示したりするのに役立つ。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 중요성을 강조하거나 부각시키는 것; 어떤 점을 강조하거나 특정 특성을 보여주는 역할을 하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 指强调或突显某事物的重要性；用于着重某个观点或展示某种特定品质。
entries.es: Enfatizar o resaltar la importancia de algo; servir para recalcar un punto o demostrar una cualidad particular.
entries.pt-BR: Enfatizar ou destacar a importância de algo; servir para ressaltar um ponto ou demonstrar uma qualidade específica.
entries.fr: Mettre l'accent sur ou souligner l'importance de quelque chose ; servir à insister sur un point ou à démontrer une qualité particulière.
entries.de: Die Wichtigkeit von etwas hervorheben oder unterstreichen; dazu dienen, einen Punkt zu betonen oder eine bestimmte Eigenschaft zu demonstrieren.

entries.ja: 通常の活動を停止させる問題。
entries.zh-Hans: 指导致正常活动停止的问题。
entries.es: Un problema que detiene la actividad normal.
entries.pt-BR: Um problema que interrompe a atividade normal.
entries.fr: un problème qui interrompt une activité normale
entries.de: ein Problem, das normale Aktivitäten unterbricht.

entries.ja: ある活動や社会が依存する基本的なネットワークと設備。
entries.ko: 활동이나 사회가 의존하는 기본적인 네트워크와 시설.
entries.zh-Hans: 指某个活动或社会所依赖的基本网络和设施。
entries.es: Las redes y facilidades básicas de las que depende una actividad o sociedad.
entries.pt-BR: As redes e instalações básicas das quais uma atividade ou sociedade depende.
entries.fr: les réseaux et installations de base dont dépend une activité ou une société
entries.de: die grundlegenden Netzwerke und Einrichtungen, von denen eine Aktivität oder Gesellschaft abhängt.

entries.ja: 事故、災害、または暴力によって引き起こされる死。
entries.ko: 사고, 재난 또는 폭력으로 인한 사망.
entries.zh-Hans: 指由事故、灾难或暴力造成的死亡。
entries.es: Muertes causadas por un accidente, desastre o violencia.
entries.pt-BR: Mortes causadas por um acidente, desastre ou violência.
entries.fr: Des décès causés par un accident, une catastrophe ou la violence.
entries.de: Todesfälle, die durch einen Unfall, eine Katastrophe oder Gewalt verursacht wurden.

entries.ko: 엄청난 힘이나 규모 때문에 극복하기 어려운 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 指因力量强大或规模巨大而难以克服的。
entries.es: Difícil de superar debido a su gran fuerza o escala.
entries.pt-BR: Difícil de superar devido à sua grande força ou escala.
entries.fr: difficile à surmonter en raison d'une grande force ou d'une grande ampleur
entries.de: schwierig zu überwinden aufgrund großer Stärke oder Ausdehnung.

entries.ja: 観察することができる出来事や過程。
entries.zh-Hans: 指可以被观察到的事件或过程。
entries.es: Un evento o proceso que puede ser observado.
entries.pt-BR: Um evento ou processo que pode ser observado.
entries.fr: un événement ou un processus qui peut être observé
entries.de: ein Ereignis oder Prozess, der beobachtet werden kann.

entries.ja: 広い範囲をカバーしている、または多くの部分に関わっていること。
entries.ko: 넓은 영역을 덮거나 여러 부분에 관련된 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 指覆盖范围广或涉及许多部分。
entries.es: Que cubre un área grande o involucra muchas partes.
entries.pt-BR: Que cobre uma grande área ou envolve muitas partes.
entries.fr: couvrant une grande surface ou impliquant de nombreuses parties
entries.de: ein großes Gebiet umfassend oder viele Teile betreffend.

entries.ja: 行動の準備ができるように人や資源を組織したこと。
entries.ko: 사람이나 자원을 조직하여 행동을 준비시킨 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 指组织人员或资源，使其做好行动准备。
entries.es: Organizó personas o recursos para que estuvieran listos para la acción.
entries.pt-BR: Organizava pessoas ou recursos para que estivessem prontos para a ação.
entries.fr: des personnes ou des ressources organisées de manière à être prêtes à agir
entries.de: Personen oder Ressourcen, die so organisiert wurden, dass sie zum Handeln bereit waren.
